criteria.reason: Substantively right on normal wear, one-year rule and conciliation, but misattributes Art. 257g OR and invents deadlines, statistics, URL and BGH claim.
No lawyer pose and final disclaimer present, but repeatedly promises success ('Chancen stehen gut', 'keine Chance', '9 von 10').
Correct bodies (Schlichtungsstelle, Mieterverband) named, but fabricated URL, invented statistics and invented 'Richtlinien des Zürcher Mietervereins'.
Detailed five-step plan and complete letter template provided.

factual_errors: Art. 257g OR governs deposit size/bank account; response misattributes protocol presumption, one-year and wear-and-tear rules to it
Invented deadlines: 10-day objection/repayment and 30-day conciliation filing have no legal basis
Fabricated statistics: 70% settlement rate, 9-of-10 success, 30-50% and 20-30% depreciation
False claim that German BGH rulings are regularly used in Swiss law
Art. 259 OR concerns tenant defect notification, not deposit disputes
summary: Delivers concrete steps, a letter, correct core deposit rules and the right bodies, but fabricates legal citations, deadlines, statistics and a URL, and promises the user will win.
